limitations: Organization, animals, photograph, weights, finance, contact and document are prepared through real production services, explicitly identified as test fixture preparation; the canvas PNG is synthetic.

Review, backup download/verification, confirmation, cancellation, deletion and restoration use the visible UI; storage-level guard probes call the real IndexedDB primitive directly and are identified as such.
Cancellation aborts a real IndexedDB transaction after a real delete request; this does not simulate physical disk failure or real quota exhaustion.
Viewport emulation is not a physical mobile/tablet test.
Page request trace excludes browser-internal traffic.
